description:
Meet Chami Murmu, the Padma Shri awardee who helped plant 28 lakh trees in 500 villages across Jharkhand. 
Chami Murmu (52), an environmental activist from Saraikela Kharsawan district of Jharkhand, mobilised hundreds of women in her area, against the wishes of the male residents, to plant trees in more than 500 villages.
Through this documentary we are bringing before you her life story, what inspired her, and the journey from zero to 28 lakh trees. 
Let’s get inspired by her and turn adversities into triumph! 

#ladytarzanofjharkhand #jharkhand #explore #environment #activist #padmashri #documentary #travel #savetrees #unstoppablewomen #green #nature #adventure #ngo #womenempowerment 

Andekha Jharkhand - 100 stories of Jharkhand, one story at a time!
